title: Schedule 1 (Form 1040) — Additional Income and Adjustments to Income
rationale: Schedule E net K-1 ordinary income of $180,000 flows to Schedule 1 line 5 and then line 10. S-corp shareholder health insurance of $14,400 is deducted on line 17 and flows to line 26. Net effect on Form 1040: $180,000 additional income less $14,400 adjustments = $165,600.
